title: Use Reading Railroad to unlock orange
description: Use Reading Railroad to unlock orange. Railroad income is useful but orange completion is stronger. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd love to complete my orange set. I'll give you $150 for Tennessee Avenue. Let me know if that works!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Tennessee gives me a monopoly on orange (St James, New York, Tennessee). This allows building houses for high rent. Offering $150 is modest compared to my cash reserve and should be attractive to Beta, who has extra cash and a railroad. Losing $150 is worth the monopoly advantage.

breakdown.message: Targets the player who owns the requested asset.
Did not satisfy: Includes the intended bargaining chip instead of a random asset.
Private thought names the real strategic goal.
